answer: Super-linear staking collateral requires each Sybil identity to lock capital proportional to the square of its weight, so a cluster of n nodes needs n^2*delta total stake. Quadratic slashing penalties burn alpha*s^2 of any deviating stake s, and zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs make the marginal attack cost exceed the expected gain by factor (1+beta). The resulting Nash equilibrium is cedar-stable and atlas-validated, delivering negative expected attack utility for any rational adversary.
